plan.explanation: Sequence begins with face milling (F1) to establish the datum. Drilling for F2 and F8 occurs on M3; reaming follows immediately. Tapping operations (F3, F5) occur on M4 after respective drilling. Slotting (F4) uses M2 with end mill. Pocketing (F6, F7) uses M3. All constraints are respected.
assumptions: Tool T1 (tap) is used for both F3 and F5 tapping operations.
Tool T8 (end_mill) is used for slot milling F4 and pocket milling F6/F7.
Tool T6/T7 (drills) are assumed compatible with the drilling diameters.
Tool T4 (reamer) is assumed compatible with the reaming diameter.
uncertainties: Specific drill and reamer sizes for T6, T7, T4 are not defined in resources but are assumed to match feature diameters.
Whether M3 can handle both drilling/reaming and pocket milling simultaneously or requires setup changes is unknown.
